data.narrative:
Pivot Bio, a Series C robotics and manufacturing company founded by Alvin Tamsir and Karsten Temme, has raised $921M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of nine companies: eight private robotics firms including Exotec, Bedrock Robotics, Dexterity, and Hadrian, plus one public comparable (ticker 277810.KQ).

Two triangulation methods apply. Stage-progression analysis uses the $921M raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 1.7x multiplier typical for Series C progression, yielding $1.6B. Peer-median analysis across seven same-sector and same/adjacent-stage companies produces a median valuation of $1.6B, with a distribution ranging from $1.0B to $2.0B. The peer set includes Series B valuations of $1.6B–$2.0B (Dexterity, Generalist AI, Bedrock Robotics) and Series D valuations of $1.6B–$2.0B (Hadrian, Exotec), anchoring the middle of the range.

Both methods converge on a median of $1.6B. The triangulated valuation range is $1.3B (low) to $1.9B (high), with $1.6B as the midpoint. Key uncertainties include stage-stage comparability across the peer set and the relevance of the single public comparable. The narrow agreement between stage-progression and peer-median approaches supports confidence in the $1.3B–$1.9B range.
